comparison.title: Keyboard navigation in the BlockNote editor
comparison.description: Demonstration baseline. In live mode Before and After are identical until an actual patch is supplied; the demo fixtures intentionally simulate a focus difference. Do not claim a fix without an observed difference.

steps.instruction: Focus the editor using the keyboard. Check whether the focused element is identifiable.
steps.expectedBefore: Record where focus lands in the unmodified editor.
steps.expectedAfter: Focus should reach the editor predictably; record whether the change affects it.

steps.instruction: Select text using the keyboard and attempt to open and navigate the formatting toolbar.
steps.expectedBefore: Describe which toolbar controls can be reached, their names and the focus sequence.
steps.expectedAfter: The intended control should be keyboard-operable, with equivalent editing behavior.

steps.instruction: Close an open formatting or slash menu with Escape and continue editing.
steps.expectedBefore: Record whether focus returns to a usable editing position.
steps.expectedAfter: Focus should return to a usable editing position, with content preserved.

steps.instruction: Repeat the interaction at 320px, light, dark, forced-colours light and forced-colours dark.
steps.expectedBefore: Record any clipped controls, invisible focus indicators or confusing system-colour behavior.
steps.expectedAfter: Record what actually changed. Automated checks do not establish WCAG conformance.
